title: Google Provider: Test Harness
description:
Implement the full Google provider test harness.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan: docs/plans/04-provider-google-test-harness.md (all sections)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P6 (message conversion stability, thoughtSignature byte-exact round-trip, finish reason completeness, safety settings coverage, camelCase verification, usage/cost consistency)
- Stub server tests S1 + fault injection F1-F5 (truncated stream, malformed JSON, HTTP errors, cancellation, prompt safety block)
- Oracle tests O1-O2 (Gemini SDK comparison, cross-provider event sequence)
- Simulations S1-S2 (stream state machine, concurrent provider usage)
- Benchmarks B1-B4 (SSE >50K/s, message conversion >100K/s, request serialization >50K/s, thought signature >1M/s)
- Soak SK1-SK2 (10K sequential replays, mixed fixture soak)
- Security SEC1-SEC2 (API key leak, thought signature opacity)
- Coverage >= 85%

Depends on: Shared Test Infrastructure (aiag-jj7.1), Google Core (aiag-gjz.1)
